newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Transilvania fund 96 profit at 2.9 bln lei.
newsitem.headline: Romania Transilvania fund 96 profit at 2.9 bln lei.

text.p: Romanian Fondul Mutual Transilvania unit trust, one of the country's 16 open-ended investment funds, said on Tuesday its maiden net profit was 2.9 billion lei ($441,290) in 1996.
The value of units went up by 85.3 percent to 18,525 lei since the fund, managed by the Globinvest SA investment company, was launched in February 1996.
The trust's net assets soared to 5.5 billion lei ($785,700) at end-1996 from 3.8 million lei when it became operational, Transilvania fund annual report said.
It said some 80 percent of its portfolio were placements in commercial papers or shares, while the remaining part were bank deposits and current accounts.

Last year, the investment funds sector was shaken when the largest trust, FMOA, fell 45 percent or $71 million in worth following a rule by capital market regulator CNVM compelling funds to report actual net assets rather than projected values.
The new rule triggered falls at most funds with depositors rushing to redeem their units. Transilvania fund said it had overcame that crisis by increasing liquidity.
The fund plans to diversify its portfolio to focus more on investments in securities, including state treasury bills or municipal and corporate bonds.
It operates through Banca Trasilvania SA and Banca Ion Tiriac SA private banks units covering about 26 major town across Romania.
